messages:
emma-newhire: Hi all ":wave:" quick onboarding questions from week 1 — 1) My offer said Redwood observes Federal holidays but Im unsure about floating holidays / observance rules (I started 2024-11-27). Do I get Thanksgiving and the Friday off? 2) My state moved from NY to NJ last month; I updated Workday but worried the first paycheck withheld NY taxes. Who to ping for retro state withholding? 3) I had a dentist visit on 2024-11-22 (pre-start) and paid out-of-pocket. If carrier backdates coverage, can that be reimbursed? Receipt attached in DM.

lori-peopleops: Welcome @emma-newhire and congrats on joining! Short answers: (1) Redwood follows the published holiday calendar — employees who start before the holiday are eligible. Thanksgiving (11/28) and the observed Friday (11/29) are paid holidays for full-time staff. We also offer 2 floating holidays / yr; those must be requested via the PTO page in Console. (2) For state withholding, if Workday was updated after payroll cut-off we can submit a delta request for retroactive withholding. Please DM your employee ID and last 4 SSN to payroll securely or upload within Workday docs. (3) For the dental claim: if benefits carrier confirms retroactive effective date we ask you to file a member claim first; if denied, People Ops can do a one-time manual reimbursement with receipts + proof of retro effective date.

payroll-bot: Automated: State withholding changes in Workday must be submitted before payroll cutoff (T-7 days) to affect the same pay run. Delta payroll requests may take 1-2 pay cycles. For retroactive state tax corrections, include proof of address change and date. See /payroll/delta-guide.

emma-newhire: Thanks! DMed emp ID and uploaded the dentist receipt. My Workday change timestamp shows 2024-11-15T09:12:00Z.

dylan-hr: @lori @payroll-bot noted. We'll validate the timestamps and if NY withholding occurred we'll open a payroll correction. @emma-newhire if we need to process reimbursement via payroll it may be taxable; we'd prefer carrier claim if possible. Benefits team: can you confirm carrier rules for retro on dental plans?

benefits-bot: Filing: carrier reply expected 48-72 hrs. If carrier approves retro the member should submit claim in their portal attaching marriage/event or enrollment confirmation. If denied, submit expense with code "benefits-exception" and attach carrier denial + receipt. People Ops will coordinate.

lori-peopleops: Looping back: confirmed Thanksgiving + Fri observed are paid. Floating holiday request -> use PTO console and put manager on request. We'll track payroll delta once HR confirms state change. We'll update this thread when carrier responds. Welcome again :tada:
